source.command: Unity -batchmode -buildTarget OSXUniversal -projectPath W/proj_es_fix1 -executeMethod FrontRoomsThreeView.RunBatch -quit -threeViewOut W/es_fix1/r2/threeview/raw -threeViewOnly Kit_ExitSign,Kit_ExitSign_Dead,Kit_ExitSign_Hanging,Kit_ExitSign_Hanging_Dead,Kit_ExitSign_HangingFlush,Kit_ExitSign_HangingFlush_Dead,Kit_ExitSign_End,Kit_ExitSign_End_Dead -threeViewYaw Kit_ExitSign_End=-90,Kit_ExitSign_End_Dead=-90 -frGlassRT off

conventions.pngPerSheetPx: PNG px = 2 x sheet px; place each PNG at 50 % so the sheet reads at sheetPpm
conventions.sheetPpmNote: The tool's ladder: the largest step whose third-angle layout (W + D wide, D + H tall) fits the 1080 x 688 drawing area. Wall, flush and end read at 2000. The hanging sign (0.612 m with its stems) drops to 500: at 1000 its D + H is 691 px, 3 px over 688.
conventions.groundLine: Part-frame kits: drawn about their origin, not on a floor. Wall and end: the PNG bottom (less padding) is the housing bottom. Hanging and flush: the PNG top (less padding) is the ceiling plane, the sign hangs below it. aboveFloor_m = the bottom's height in the game where the game places the kit, else null
conventions.views: third-angle: front = camera on +Z (the sign face), side = the kit's right (camera on -X), top = from above with the front toward the image bottom, persp = 3/4 hero from the front-left, 22 deg up, 1152 x 864
conventions.viewYaw: -90 on Kit_ExitSign_End(_Dead): its faces are +/-X (a flag mount), so it is turned to show the +X face in the front view. The wall plate is then at image left and the sign projects to the right; size_m and dims are in that turned frame (W = projection from the wall)
conventions.litFace: Lit kits render the diffuser at the material default _LampField (1, 1, 0, 0) = both AC lamps (the LIT temperament, no driver in the studio). The studio camera has no HDR and no post, so the letters clip to a full red (mean #e40f08; #e52f2b before exit_sign_fix1). Dead kits use ExitSign_Diffuser_Dead (no emission)
conventions.swatchRule: hex = sRGB of ( linear(mean of the _BaseMap's sRGB pixels) x linear(_BaseColor) ), read from Resources/Surfaces/<slot>.mat in the render clone (interactables/threeview/tools/swatch.py); Prop_Chrome reuses the existing K-sheet hex (equal under the rule). The glow swatch is the emission colour at its peak

verification.checks: 32 / 32 PNGs: exactly 16 px clear margin on every side, 0 opaque black px, 0 magenta; 8 / 8 kits ok, none failed
verification.topViewNote: The ceiling kits' top views look into the canopy pan, which is open on its ceiling side (exit_sign_common.build_canopy); its shadow marks the footprint

sheets.title: Exit sign
sheets.lede: Over the Exit room's far door: 6 in stencil letters cut through white enamel, two lamps behind red acrylic.

era.label: Period
era.note: An incandescent stencil-face sign of the late 1970s to the early 1990s: 6 in letters with 3/4 in strokes (1:8, within the 1:8–1:12 of most signs in Cohn 1978; NFPA 101-1988, UL 924 of 1989), built like the USACE Type 602/604 drawings of 1985–86 (two 20 W lamps behind red acrylic). No LED sign was in NIST's August 1990 sample. Red letters, both chevrons closed; no LED, no running man, no brand, no date.

materials.name: ExitSign_Housing
materials.label: White enamel (pan)
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/ExitSign_Housing.mat: mean of ExitSign_Enamel_A.png x _BaseColor [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] (tint sRGB->linear, product -> sRGB); metallic 0, smoothness = the _S mask's R (capped at 0.60) x _Smoothness 1

materials.name: ExitSign_Face
materials.label: Stencil plate, white enamel
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/ExitSign_Face.mat: mean of ExitSign_Face_A.png x _BaseColor [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] (tint sRGB->linear, product -> sRGB); metallic 0, smoothness = the _S mask's R (capped at 0.60) x _Smoothness 1

materials.name: ExitSign_Diffuser
materials.label: Red acrylic diffuser
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/ExitSign_Diffuser.mat: mean of ExitSign_Diffuser_A.png x _BaseColor [1.0, 0.248, 0.248] (tint sRGB->linear, product -> sRGB); metallic 1, smoothness = the _S mask's R (capped at 0.60) x _Smoothness 0.3; ExitSign_Diffuser_Dead has the same albedo, tint, smoothness and metallic

materials.name: ExitSign_Diffuser (glow)
materials.label: Lit letters (lamp glow)
materials.source: ExitSign_Diffuser.mat _EmissionColor (3.2, 0.013, 0.006) linear, shown at its peak (R = 1); the shader multiplies it by the lamp field (ExitSign_Diffuser_F: letter means E/X/I/T 0.51 / 0.59 / 1 / 0.58, LIT). renderedHex = mean of the lit letters in Kit_ExitSign_front.png (studio, no HDR, no post; median #f40d06). In game the letters pass bloom and ACES: exit_sign_fix1 measured the graded letter body at hue 6.9–8.0°, saturation 0.80–0.83 (lit and dark rooms, 0.3–12 m; research/exit_sign/60_fix1.md §3)
